title: Phone remote
guidance: Let paired phones on the same private network read lyrics and control playback.
noInterface: No private network found. Make sure this computer is on your home or studio Wi-Fi or wired network.
firewall: Windows may ask to allow connections the first time. Allow private networks only.
pairingTitle: Scan with your phone or open this address
pairingHint: This code works once, within two minutes. After a phone scans it, you still allow it here.

errors.no-interface: The chosen network isn't available. Choose another.
errors.public-network: Windows treats this network as public. Change it to private in Windows Settings, then turn this on.
errors.port-in-use: Another app is using this port. Choose a different one.
errors.secure-storage-unavailable: This computer can't encrypt pairing data right now, so the phone remote can't turn on.
errors.listen-failed: The phone remote couldn't turn on. Try again later.
errors.not-running: Turn on the phone remote first.
errors.invalid: That setting isn't valid. Enter it again.
errors.read-failed: The phone remote status can't be read right now.

page.unpaired: This phone isn't paired. On the computer, open Settings → Phone remote, choose Pair a phone, then scan the QR code.
page.pairing-failed: Pairing didn't finish. The code may have expired or been used. Create a new one on the computer and scan again.
page.devices-full: The paired phone limit is reached. Remove an unused phone in the computer's Settings first.
page.awaiting-approval: Choose Allow on the computer. Check that it shows the same code:
page.pairing-denied: The computer refused this pairing. If this is your phone, create a new code on the computer and scan again.
page.pairing-busy: The computer is confirming another phone. Scan again shortly.

results.stale: The display just changed. Tap again.
results.unavailable: Can't do that now. Check that the computer is playing.
results.busy: The computer is busy. Try again shortly.
results.timed_out: The computer didn't respond. Try again.

approval.label: Confirm new phone
approval.title: Allow “{name}” to connect?
approval.hint: Check that the phone shows the same code. If it isn't your phone, choose Deny.
